title: [喜訊] 恭喜EMRD108級林嚴之碩士論文投稿期刊論文刊登發表!
html:
恭賀!!!

108級林嚴學長與指導教授資管系黃政嘉教授一序列長期努力，將EMRD碩士論文轉投期刊論文，完成刊登發表囉!

此為EMRD碩士論文第一篇投稿期刊成功刊登的論文，為EMRD建立一個新的里程碑!!

論文名稱：A Review of PCI Express Protocol-Based Systems in Response to 5G Application Demand

Abstract: https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/11/5/678

PDF Version: https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/11/5/678/pdf

發表期刊： published in Electronics as part of the Special Issue Security Challenges and Opportunities of Mobile System/5G/Internet of Things (IoT) Scenarios
